title: Response body and chunk parsing would handle non-hex or negative integers incorrectly which could… (CVE-2026-103995)
description: CVE-2026-103995 is a vulnerability involving incorrect handling of non-hexadecimal or negative integers during HTTP response body and chunk parsing. This flaw could cause misinterpretation of HTTP response contents. The vulnerability has a low severity rating and no known exploits in the wild. No affected versions or patches are specified.
